steps.say: Angstrom Signals comes with a library of Groups and Sets, built around common trading situations. | In Prism, open Provided by Angstrom Signals.
Each one shows small icons for what it looks at. | Here: volume, and structure, the support and resistance levels.
Underneath, one line says what it describes, in plain words.
Tap more for three parts: | what it measures, | why traders watch it, | and what it doesn't prove.
The last icon is the evidence mark. | A microscope means not yet studied. | A balance means it was studied, and showed no clear difference. | The next two videos explain both.
To find one quickly, tap an icon in the filter row. | Here, only the Sets that look at volatility.
Tap plus, and a provided Set becomes one of your Prism scans, ready to run.
Signal Groups and Signal Sets have the same library at the top. | And the Start from list offers them too, after New, and before your own.
Once you know them, one setting hides everything provided. | Descriptive readings, not advice.
